The corrected edition uses one upward rounding mode and separately bounded reciprocal powers. It reports complete perimeter1900 reruns at all three activities, exact small Fraction comparisons, independent220-digit coefficient/scalar review and subnormal convolution checks. Corrected marked log upper is -6215.6619158297..., retaining W_cut/ZA<=exp(-6215) at R200 under explicit64-bit-mantissa/compiler/Decimal assumptions. Old raw certificates remain unverified history; earlier occupation arguments use different arithmetic.
